units.source_text: 除了时常想念故去的父母外，我没有什么不愉快的。

en.t: Apart from often thinking of my late parents, I had nothing to make me unhappy.

units.source_text: 我和叔叔全家一起度过这个夏天之后，又回到东京去了。

en.t: After spending that summer with my uncle and his family, I went back to Tokyo again.

units.source_text: 只是，这个夏天里发生的一件事，在我心中投下了一层淡淡的阴影，即叔叔夫妇一起劝我这个高中生结婚的事。

en.t: Only one thing that happened that summer cast a faint shadow over my heart: my uncle and his wife both urged me, still a high school student, to marry.

units.source_text: 而且，前前后后提了有三四回。

en.t: What is more, they brought it up three or four times altogether.

units.source_text: 由于事出突然，起初我只是感到十分惊愕。

en.t: Because it came so suddenly, at first I was simply very astonished.

units.source_text: 第二次提起时，我便干脆拒绝了。

en.t: The second time they mentioned it, I flatly refused.

units.source_text: 当他们第三次提起此事时，我终于忍不住反问，为什么这样做。

en.t: When they brought it up for the third time, I finally could not help asking them in return why they wanted this.

units.source_text: 他们的想法很简单，只是说，你早点儿娶媳妇，好回这个家来，继承亡父的家业。

en.t: Their idea was very simple: they only said that I should take a wife soon, come back to this house, and inherit my late father's household estate.

units.source_text: 我那时觉得，自己只要放假回来就可以了。

en.t: At the time, I thought it would be enough if I simply came back during vacations.

units.source_text: 为继承父亲的家业，应该结婚，二者似乎都有道理。

en.t: To inherit my father's household estate, I ought to marry; both points seemed to have a certain logic.

units.source_text: 我熟知乡下的习俗，能够理解叔叔的提议，我也并非对此事特别反感。

en.t: I knew the customs of the countryside well and could understand my uncle's proposal, and I was not especially opposed to it.

units.source_text: 但是，对于刚刚到东京求学的我来说，那是很遥远的事，就仿佛从望远镜里看到的景物一般。

en.t: But to me, who had only just gone to Tokyo to study, it was something very distant, like a scene seen through a telescope.

units.source_text: 我没有同意叔叔的安排，再次离开了我的家乡。

en.t: Without agreeing to my uncle's arrangements, I left my hometown once again.
